data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 双环 harness 的恢复技能经执行失败反思改进，并在后续复用，符合方法型持续自改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: When execution fails, the system invokes reusable control-based recovery skills that restore task progress and are refined through reflection on earlier failures.
scope_support.object_quote: When execution fails, the system invokes reusable control-based recovery skills that restore task progress and are refined through reflection on earlier failures.
